family.description: This is a conserved domain containing the catalytic zinc-metallopeptidase (HExxH) catalytic motif. Proteins containing this domain are found in some archaebacteria, as well as Helicobacter pylori. The proteins are 190-240 amino acids long, with the C terminus being the most conserved region, containing three conserved histidines [[cite:PUB00098014],[cite:PUB00098016],[cite:PUB00098015],[cite:PUB00084997]]. This domain is found in YgjP from E. coli [[cite:PUB00084997]], a predicted metal-dependent hydrolase that hydrolyses UTP to UMP and diphosphate in vitro; and in MJ0123 from Methanocaldococcus jannaschii (also referred to as projannalysin) [[cite:PUB00098015]].
family.name: YgjP-like, metallopeptidase domain

causal_graphs.context: 50 ug/mL purified enzyme with 10 mM UTP; three replicates, mean and SD. Mass-spectrometric UTP and UMP ion traces compared with heat-inactivated YgjP. Selected TALON and anion-exchange fractions are shown in Figure 16b. Assay buffer, temperature and heat-inactivation protocol were not verified.

evidence.explanation: Visually inspected Supplementary Figure 16a-c and parsed Table 9 row 10 support the net preparation-level product assignment with a heat-inactivated comparator; exact assay and construct limitations remain explicit.
evidence.snippet: Experimental validation of the novel enzyme YgjP (Upp).

edges.mechanism: UTP m/z 482.961 declines while UMP m/z 323.029 rises relative to the heat-inactivated comparator. Table 9 reports slow UTP-to-UMP conversion and negative tests with ATP, GTP, CTP, dTTP and ITP; it does not establish physiological specificity or a measured PPi stoichiometry.
edges.subject: active-ygjp-with-utp

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Table 3 identifies b3085/ygjP. Reference P42597 sequence version 2 exactly equals BAE77135.1 and AAC76120.2, 167 aa; PF01863 94-149. The reference is K-12, but exact historical ASKA clone sequence, donor strain and expression host remain unverified. No residue-specific or isolated-domain attribution.
causal_graphs.limitations: DIRECT means a net purified-preparation effect, not proof of a chemical microstep or exclusion of every copurifying activity. Distinct ion response scales preclude molar stoichiometry or kcat. PPi appears in the reaction scheme, not a separately quantified trace. Main article Methods and full cellular datasets were not inspected.

causal_graphs.family_mapping: PAB3079 Q9V1Y2 version 1 equals CAB49216.1, 105 aa; Pyrococcus abyssi GE5 reference taxon 272844. PF01863 2-88 excludes the deleted M104/V105 sites. Reference and PDB 4JIU establish L2V in the recombinant scaffold, contradicting the paper's K2V label. Separate deletion sequences were not deposited in the inspected sources.
causal_graphs.limitations: Preparation-level thermal effects, not isolated-domain sufficiency, quantified unfolding energetics or protease activation. The published WT comparator is the recombinant full-length scaffold. Different purification heat treatments and missing raw thermal curves limit mechanistic attribution; the two deletions do not isolate the contribution of M104 alone.

causal_graphs.family_mapping: MJ0123 Q57587 version 1 equals AAB98111.1, 110 aa; JAL-1/DSM 2661 taxon 243232. PF01863 7-95 contains H69/E70/H73 and H81 but excludes E102-I110. PDB 4JIX has K2A plus residual N-terminal GP after His6/TEV cleavage; native numbering, not polymer seq_id, is used.
causal_graphs.limitations: The proposed trans-blocking mechanism is not directly tested by a folded active product. The five-residue deletion and limited-proteolysis attempts were unsuccessful.
